steward_note: deterministic-enclave-5section-v2: Pacing=MULLIGAN_CRISIS; Pre-Roll DC=14; Science Vegetable='Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea'; Active POV=enclave_01_hector -> Handoff=enclave_05_kaio.
science_vegetable: Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea
summary: Hector attempts to stabilize the relay anchor amid the violent magnetic sheer before tossing the calibration baton to Kaio.

horizon_goals.immediate_session_goal: Anchor the relay against the magnetic shear
horizon_goals.campaign_arc_climax: Prevent the encroaching ferrofluid wave from causing a total polarity inversion

active_location.macro_silhouette: The First Forge's heavy brass bulkheads ground and hummed, an anchor resisting the immense pressure of the magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear tearing across the ferrofluid sea just outside. Sputtering blue lightning arced across hand-forged copper armatures, casting long, erratic shadows across the slick basalt floor. Outside, jet-black metallic waves crested violently against the retaining walls, threatening to overwhelm the structural tolerances.

sensory_palette.sight_and_color: blinding azure electrical arcs against matte jet-black metallic waves
sensory_palette.sound: a relentless, bone-rattling hum of sheer magnetic force punishing the stressed brass bulkheads
sensory_palette.smell: acrid, burning ozone thickly layered over the heavy, metallic scent of cold iron
sensory_palette.tactile_temperature: a biting, localized chill radiating from the basalt floor beneath the oppressive ambient heat of the electrical discharge
sensory_palette.taste_optional: a sharp, battery-acid tang clinging to the back of the throat

interactive_features.affordance_description: Can be locked into place to distribute the sheer force across the bedrock.
Can draw away the sheer kinetic force of the ferrofluid impact if properly aligned.
Can safely dissipate the excess thermal load before the brass bulkheads warp.

reactive_toys.motivation_goal: Overwhelm structural integrity of the Enclave.
reactive_toys.immediate_complication: A massive rogue wave of magnetized liquid is cresting directly toward the primary mast.
reactive_toys.uninterrupted_escalation: The wave will crush the outer retaining wall and flood the forge floor with lethal charge.

three_levels_of_why.level_1_immediate: The Kelvin-Helmholtz shear is buckling the relay anchor, threatening immediate catastrophic discharge.
three_levels_of_why.level_2_local: If the anchor fails, The First Forge will be ripped apart by the feral magnetic tide.
three_levels_of_why.level_3_campaign_arc: The exoplanet's living environment fundamentally rejects stationary Enclave engineering, requiring constant adaptation.

judge_tactician.failure_stakes_declared: The anchor fractures, unleashing a localized arc-flash that severely burns the immediate area.

graduated_outcomes.nat_1_false_intuition: Hector overtightens the coupling, causing a micro-fracture that exacerbates the charge buildup.
graduated_outcomes.below_dc_complicated_fail_forward: The anchor holds, but the back-surge blows out the secondary lighting arrays, plunging the forge into gloom.
graduated_outcomes.meets_dc_clean_success: Hector expertly locks the anchor point, stabilizing the mast against the encroaching tide.
graduated_outcomes.dc_plus_5_or_20_extended_lore: Hector discovers a way to permanently reinforce the mast using the very resonance of the shear.

master_narrator.agency_handoff_prompt: Hector snatched the heavy copper baton from the air, ignoring the stinging static discharge that bit through his gloves. The air around him screamed as the magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear battered the bulkheads. He threw his weight against the relay anchor, muscle and grit forcing the locking mechanism down until it snapped tight with a satisfying metallic clang. Without hesitation, he spun and tossed the baton towards Kaio's waiting grip. 'Your turn, keep the resonance aligned!'
